name: Church & Dwight
outlook:
What Church & Dwight says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted tax rateOur adjusted tax rate is expected to be approximately 21%.
  • Full year 2026: earnings per shareWe now expect full-year reported EPS to increase approximately 20%. We also expect Adjusted EPS growth for 2026 of 7%, tightening the range from our prior expectation of 6% to 8%.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: sales and adjusted earnings per shareFor the fourth quarter, we expect reported sales decline of approximately 0.5%, driven entirely by the strategic portfolio actions taken in 2025. We expect organic sales growth of approximately 4.0%¹ and continued gross margin expansion. Overall adjusted EPS is expected to increase 17% to 19% versus last year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
